report.evidenceOnlyMA: Only possible microaneurysms were marked. On the ICDR scale, microaneurysms alone correspond to mild non-proliferative DR.
report.evidenceHemorrhages: Possible hemorrhages were marked in {{quadrants}} of 4 quadrants, with 20 or more in {{with20}} of them. On the ICDR scale, 20 or more hemorrhages in each of the 4 quadrants is a sign of severe non-proliferative DR.

clinical.disclaimer: Screening aid only. Results are produced by automated image analysis and are not a medical diagnosis, and the tool can miss disease. It has not been clinically validated. Always have a qualified eye-care professional review the findings before making any treatment decision.

No_DR.title: Overall Assessment: Stage 0 – No DR detected

clinical.idleNote: Upload fundus images for both eyes and run the AI assessment to see the screening result.

none.title: No Assessment Yet
none.sub: Upload both fundus images on the dashboard and run the AI assessment. Nothing on this page should be read as a result until then.

noReferral.title: No Referral Flagged
noReferral.sub: The screening model did not flag diabetic retinopathy in either eye. This does not rule out disease: the tool can miss it. Continue regular eye screening as advised by your eye-care professional.

followUp.title: Follow-up Recommended
followUp.sub: The screening model detected mild changes. Follow-up with an eye-care professional is recommended; ask them how often you should be screened.

referral.title: Specialist Review Recommended
referral.sub: The screening model flagged possible diabetic retinopathy in at least one eye. Review by an eye-care professional is recommended; this result cannot be acted on automatically.

clinical.basisScore: Basis: referral score compared with a {{threshold}} threshold
clinical.basisScoreSite: Basis: referral score compared with a {{threshold}} threshold set by this site
clinical.referralChipHint: The most likely stage is lower, but the screening model's referral threshold was reached
clinical.heatmapNote: Shows the regions that raised this eye's referral score, on a coarse grid. A rough guide, not a lesion detection: warm colours do not by themselves mean disease, and disease can be present outside them.
clinical.heatmapEmpty: No region raised this eye's referral score, so nothing is highlighted. That does not rule out disease.
clinical.lesionNote: Coloured areas are possible lesions for a clinician to check, not findings. In testing, the lesion model marked something in about 1 in 3 eyes that had no retinopathy, and it misses some lesions.
clinical.lesionNoneNote: The lesion model marked nothing in this photograph. That does not rule out disease.
clinical.pdfNeedsAssessment: Run the AI assessment first; the PDF report is made from its result.
clinical.pdfNeedsPhotos: The photographs are no longer in this session. Upload them and run the assessment again to make a PDF report.
clinical.englishOnly: This result text is shown in English only, because no checked-in-advance sentence exists for it in this language.

tour.replayTitle: Take the tour of the website
tour.noVoice: This device has no {{language}} voice, so the tour is shown as text only.
tour.notReviewed: Spoken {{language}} is switched off until the translation has been checked, so the tour is shown as text only.
tour.unsupported: This browser cannot read text aloud, so the tour is shown as text only.

welcome.title: Welcome to Retina Rescue
welcome.text: This tour walks you through a full eye screening. At most steps you do the task yourself: the tour waits for you, then moves on. Tap Next to begin, or Skip tour to close it.

profile.title: Your health record
profile.text: Your details and readings such as HbA1c and blood pressure are shown here.
profile.task: Tap the pencil to fill in your details.

patient.title: Patient details
patient.text: Your name, date of birth and diabetes readings are stored encrypted and appear on your report.
patient.task: Fill in the form and tap the save button at the bottom.

lowBandwidth.title: Slow internet?
lowBandwidth.text: Low-bandwidth mode makes photos smaller before they are sent, so they upload much faster on a slow mobile connection.
lowBandwidth.task: Tap the box to switch it on or off.

eyes.title: Upload a photo of each eye
eyes.text: Each photo is checked for focus and lighting straight away. If a photo is blurry or dark, you are asked to take it again.
eyes.task: Add a retina photo for the left eye and one for the right, and wait until both are accepted.

run.title: Assess both eyes
run.text: The AI grades each eye from Stage 0 to Stage 4 in a few seconds.
run.task: Tap this button and wait for the result.

banner.title: Your result
banner.text: The result for both eyes appears here: the stage of diabetic eye disease the AI sees, and whether it suggests seeing an eye specialist. The listen button reads it aloud.

history.title: Past exams
history.text: Each assessment is saved here, so you can see what changed in your eyes from one exam to the next.

openReport.title: Open the detailed report
openReport.text: The detailed report explains the result for each eye.
openReport.task: Tap this button to open it.

reportSummary.title: Result and referral
reportSummary.text: Here you see the result for each eye, how confident the AI is, and whether a referral to an eye specialist is suggested.

reportViews.title: See what the AI saw
reportViews.text: The AI heat map shows the areas that influenced the result. The enhanced photo and the anatomy view, with blood vessels, optic disc and fovea, help a doctor check the photo.
reportViews.task: Tap one of these views to see it.

reportPdf.title: Download the report
reportPdf.text: A PDF of the report can be shared with your doctor.
reportPdf.task: Tap the button to download it.

reportBack.title: Back to the dashboard
reportBack.text: You can open this report again at any time.
reportBack.task: Tap the back button to return to the dashboard.

openReview.title: Specialist review
openReview.text: An eye doctor can check this result in 30 seconds on the specialist review page.

review.title: The specialist's view
review.text: The doctor sees both photos with the AI evidence and records their own grade. This page is in English.
review.task: Tap Back when you are done.

openDistrict.title: District Planner
openDistrict.text: District Planner estimates the cameras, servers and staff a whole district needs.

district.title: Planning a district
district.text: This page models a district's screening programme for a year and finds the cheapest mix of cameras, servers and reviewers for it.
district.task: Tap Back when you are done.

account.title: Your account
account.text: Delete your account and all its data here, or sign out when you are done.

replay.title: That is the tour
replay.text: Tap this button any time to see the tour again.
